note: Cross-repository queries against the whole-repository index (3,789 elements, 116 submodels). The realistic case: the operator does not know which submodel holds the answer, which is exactly what the single-submodel set could not test -- every one of its queries was handed its candidate pool for free. Each case also declares the structural filter an agent could reasonably derive from the question before searching ('a Property', 'a Nameplate', 'in degC'), so the same set can be scored with filtering off and on and the difference attributed. Paths are matched without their submodel: this repository holds genuine duplicates (three TechnicalData_IMM submodels, three KinematicModels), and finding the right kind of element in any copy is a correct answer.
